name: Y-ExCL Summer Program (Evelyn K. Davis Center)
org: Lutheran Services in Iowa, Evelyn K. Davis Center for Working Families
what_you_do: Train for 2 weeks on work skills, then work 8 weeks at a job placement. You work Monday through Thursday.
pay_detail: $12.00 an hour, 20 hours a week, Monday through Thursday
duration: 10 weeks: 2 weeks of training and 8 weeks of job placement
deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2026 are closed. The program page says to check back in Spring 2027. The schedule on the page: training June 2 to 13, then job placement June 16 to August 7 (the page does not give the year).
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application through the DMACC link on the program page. Keep your email and phone number current.
notes: The center is at 1171 7th Street, Des Moines, IA 50314 (email info@evelynkdaviscenter.org). The program page gives no phone number for Y-ExCL. Another page lists 515-697-7700 and a link on it shows 515-967-7700, so check before you call.
